canonical_source.behavior: The runtime error surface exposes a raw anchor to the exact current Navigation.Uri with enhanced navigation disabled, forcing a full document navigation rather than an in-app router transition.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The runtime error boundary renders a real anchor whose href is the browser's exact current URL. Native anchor navigation performs the source-equivalent full-document reload while preserving path, query string, and fragment. No React Router Link, callback reload shim, API request, tenant route synthesis, or persistence mutation is used.

authorization.reason: This is a navigation-only recovery control on the already-rendered runtime error surface and does not execute a privileged server action.

tenant_isolation.proof: The control does not accept or construct a tenant/resource identifier; it reuses the exact current browser URL without parsing or substituting tenant state.

semantics.authoritative_reread: the browser performs a fresh document request for the exact current URL
semantics.fake_success_path: none; navigation success/failure is owned by the browser/server response

acceptance_tests.coverage: raw link role, exact current href, operation marker, path/query/hash preservation, no synthesized API destination
canonical ledger identity/domain/kind/source/control plus production source marker and absence of legacy reload callback/API mutation

canonical_denominator.note: Counts are the live generated reconciliation observed immediately before this single-operation claim; final post-merge counts must be re-read from the authoritative composition.

terminality.basis: Real source-equivalent full-document navigation is implemented and bound to the exact canonical operation ID in production code and deterministic focused tests. Generator-backed reconciliation and exact-head CI remain required before integration.
